# VitaSense AI

> A gentle, AI-powered wellness companion in a soft, pink, mindful app.

VitaSense AI pairs Haven💫 — a warm, judgement-free chat you can vent to anytime — with symptom check-ins, mood and anxiety quizzes, a wellness coach, and personalized daily tips, all in one calm space.
